I can't give you an amount for fish oil, and joints are a question for a doctor, not a coach. Fish oil is one of the most-studied supplements, but the evidence on joints is mixed, and what's right depends on your health and any medications you take. A doctor or dietitian can give you a dose that fits you.

On the training side, I can help with exercise selection, how loads and volume are managed, or building sessions around movements you want to avoid. Want me to set something up?
